title: Real Time Information Center presentation shown to Council on 2026-10-05, and any drone video played
summary:
Asks for the presentation the Police Department gave at the City Council's October 5, 2026 special meeting (Item 1, File ID 26-12644, "San Mateo Police Department Real Time Information Center — Presentation").

- Item 1: the presentation as displayed, in the electronic format the City holds it (e.g. the .pptx), with all embedded images, video and audio.
- Item 2: each video or audio file played during the presentation, including any drone (unmanned aircraft system) footage, in its native format, whether embedded or played separately, plus the link for any video played from the web.

A PDF copy is asked for too, but not as a substitute, since a PDF does not carry embedded video.

policy_promises.quote: The agency shall make the information available in any electronic format in which it holds the information.
policy_promises.tests: Does the City produce the native presentation file and the video files as played, rather than a flattened PDF?

prior_pra_refs.note: Earlier request for the report-back Council asked for after the June 2020 Flock/sUAS item; both concern drone-program material presented to Council.

filed_because: The October 5 presentation was shown on the Council Chamber screens and appears in the meeting video, but no copy was ever posted. As of 2026-10-15 the meeting's PrimeGov page still lists only the one-page agenda report ("Attachments: None"). Item 2 names drone footage specifically, so that any clips played to Council are covered whether or not they were embedded in the slides.
notes: Awaiting initial agency response; 10-day statutory determination due 2026-10-25.
